example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এঁড়ে লোক, কোনো কথাই শোনে না।
এঁড়ে স্বভাবের কারণে তার বন্ধুত্ব নষ্ট হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a stubborn person and doesn't listen to anyone.
His obstinate nature ruined his friendships.
history: This idiom draws from rural Bengali life where goats are known for their headstrong behavior, symbolizing unyielding stubbornness in human character.
note: Often used to describe someone who is rigidly opinionated.
